name: Copy field machine name
description: Adds a per-content-type admin tab that lists a bundle's fields with a one-click copy-to-clipboard button for each field machine name.
project_description:
The Copy Field module provides the ability to copy the machine name of a content type field. When creating custom themes or rendering content type data, we often need to copy the content type field's machine name. With this module, you can easily copy the machine name of a field with a single click. You can install this module in a development environment by configuring it with Config Split.

 Features 
 1. Configure this copy field module as per your need i.e, content type wise

2. Copy field machine name to clipboard and past it wherever you want

 Post-Installation 
 After installing module, Visit content type you want to add copy field feature and edit content type page admin/structure/types/manage/article here you can enable or disable copy field feature. After enable this you can see new tab Manage Copy field on admin/structure/types/manage/article 

 Additional Requirements 
 No additional requirements needed.
